english.title: Removal of trespassers - enter land before end of relevant period - CJ and PO 1994;

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a direction given under section 62A(1) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 applied to you, entered land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), in the area of the relevant local authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..), as a trespasser before the end of the relevant period with the intention of residing there
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62B(1)(b) and (3) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.

english.notes:
(a) The relevant period is the period of twelve months starting with the day on which the direction is given. (Section 62B(2)).
(b) It is a defence for the accused to show that:-
(i) he was not trespassing on the land in respect of which he is alleged to have committed the offence, or
(ii) he had a reasonable excuse for failing to leave the relevant land as soon as reasonably practicable or for entering land in the area of the relevant local authority as a trespasser with the intention of residing there,
(iii) at the time the direction was given, he was under the age of 18 years and was residing with his parent or guardian." (Section 62B(5)).
(c) This offence inserted into section 62 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 by section 61 of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.
